evidence.trustReason: Re-verification after the earlier rejection. Fix commits 27526f6b45 (return send, no behaviour change), ecefcb080a (optional write input, default TaskStatus.write, same behaviour) and 93b60f836c (tests) read; tree clean; suite run 4 times: 12 pass, 0 fail, 48 expect(), exit 0. Mutation check on a scratch copy (absolute imports, repo untouched): removing Effect.uninterruptible fails the interrupt test; Queue.unbounded instead of sliding(1) fails the burst test; removing the permit fails the done/permit race test; removing the at floor fails the resume test. Per case: TC1 stored types, at from clock (TestClock resume test rejects Date.now), publish-before-send (store failure leaves the actor log empty), permit (TC9) - covered. TC2 store order equals fold order, times sorted under TestClock - covered (race not forced; permit proven in TC9). TC3 record after done stores nothing and succeeds - covered. TC4 gated publish holds the record, interrupt lands there, fact stored and T1.1 building - covered, mutant killed (earlier gap closed). TC5 counted writes: 1 initial + 1 per fact, exact total, last cancelled/ended/stopped, writer done, touch after done adds no write - covered (earlier gap closed; the history-length toEqual at lines 342-344 is tautological for index>0, noise only). TC6 writer held in a write, 100 touches give exactly one more write equal to the last snapshot; touch after Scope.close returns Exit.void and adds no write - covered, mutant killed (earlier gap closed). TC7 aliveAt > 1e12 and a touch restamps a larger aliveAt - covered, weak (live clock only). TC8 SV21 first finalizer sees the writer fiber done - covered. TC9 forced contention via gated publish: B waits on the permit, store is run.started,run.cancelled - covered, mutant killed. TC10 publish dies: Exit failure, actor log empty; closed-scope record stores nothing - covered. TC11 touch before first change succeeds; deterministic failed write (.opencode is a file) logs the warning; next macrostep writes building, history 2 - covered (earlier gap closed). TC12 TestClock 4000 below stored 9000 gives at 9000 - covered, mutant killed. TC13 SV26: Exit failure, store count unchanged, error log line asserted, writer fiber done, touch leaves status.json unchanged - covered (earlier gap closed; the error snapshot is never written because the actor changes stream never emits an error snapshot, SD-4, so the takeWhile mutant is equivalent). No regression.
